behavioral_effects: Every file mutation in a Claude Code session now flows through tools the gates and the touched-log observe
compatibility_impact: The four filesystem MCP writers and Windows-MCP FileSystem become unusable in Claude Code sessions inside this repository only; their read tools and all use outside the repo are untouched, and native Read/Write/Edit cover the same capability through the gates
limitations: Enumerated denylist: a future machine-side MCP server with write tools is not covered until added here - keep the list short and honest rather than aspirational
reason: MCP filesystem writers bypass both the new-file gate and the PostToolUse touched-log, so a write through them is invisible to the Stop hook and can land outside any change session - native Read/Write/Edit cover the same capability through the gates, making the bypass pure loss
rollback: git revert of the single commit, or delete the deny block
security_impact: Positive - closes the last known write path that is both ungated (new-file gate matches Write|NotebookEdit only) and unlogged (touched-log matches Edit|Write only, so the Stop hook cannot see MCP writes). Claude-side steering, not a security boundary: non-Claude agents ignore these settings
summary: Deny the MCP filesystem writer tools inside the repository
